text: おわかいのが　よろこぶ　ような　おもしろい　もんは　この　しまには　ありゃせん　だが　しぜんや　れきしが　いっぱいの　いい　しまだよ　ゆっくり　して　いきなせえ

structure.jp: おわかいのが　よろこぶ　ような　おもしろい　もんは
structure.en: fun things of the kind young folks would enjoy

structure.jp: この　しまには　ありゃせん
structure.en: there are none on this island

structure.jp: しぜんや　れきしが　いっぱいの　いい　しまだよ
structure.en: it's a good island full of nature and history

structure.jp: ゆっくり　して　いきなせえ
structure.en: take it easy before you go

patterns.name: 〜ような
patterns.span: よろこぶ　ような　おもしろい　もん
patterns.explanation: ような after a verb says the next thing is of the kind that fits that description. よろこぶ　ような　おもしろい　もん = 'fun things of the kind they would enjoy'.

patterns.name: 〜はしない
patterns.explanation: Putting は and しない after a verb is a strong way of saying 'not at all'. ありゃせん is the old country-folk way of saying ありはしない. ありゃせん = 'there just isn't any'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with いく means doing something and then going on your way. なせえ is an old country way of saying なさい, a gentle order. ゆっくり　して　いきなせえ = 'take your time before you go'.
